BiblicalUsage: Jogli is named once, in Numbers 34:22. In Numbers 34:22 we read, "And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli."
TheologicalSignificance: Jogli teaches me that faithfulness does not need fame to be recorded.
